title: Sum from 1 to N Flowchart
summary: This flowchart reads a starting integer n, initializes total to 0, and loops while n > 0 to add n to total and decrease n by 1 before ending.

nodes.label: Input n
nodes.description: Reads the initial integer value for variable n.

nodes.label: Set total = 0
nodes.description: Initializes the running sum variable total to 0.

nodes.label: Is n > 0?
nodes.description: Checks whether n is still greater than 0 to continue looping.

nodes.label: total = total + n
nodes.description: Adds the current value of n into total.

nodes.label: n = n - 1
nodes.description: Decrements n by 1 before repeating the loop check.

nodes.label: End
nodes.description: Terminates execution with the computed value of total.

edges.description: Input n proceeds to Set total = 0.
Set total = 0 proceeds to decision Is n > 0?.
When n > 0 is true, proceed to total = total + n.
After updating total, proceed to n = n - 1.
Loop back from n = n - 1 to decision Is n > 0?.
When n > 0 is false, proceed to End.
